{{Quote|There was this rich Duros scumbag - Cada Bliss. Obsessed with Twi'lek women, artifacts, clothes - anything. We took him for everything he was worth.|Vette|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Cada Bliss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] criminal active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A rich [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] obsessed with collecting everything about Twi'lek culture, Cada Bliss fell victim to a heist organized by a Twi'lek gang. Led by [[Taunt]] and including [[Vette]], [[Plasmajack]] and [[Flash (Twi'lek)|Flash]], the gang stripped Bliss of almost everything valuable. Bliss's revenge on the gang was hard: mercenaries were set on their tail and Vette was captured and sold into slavery. Taunt and the others tracked down Bliss in return, hoping for eventual payback. By the time Vette changed hands and ended up with a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]], Bliss has acquired a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] artifact called the [[Star of Kala'unn]]. Driven by her desire to take the artifact back, Vette convinced the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to confront Cada Bliss and his [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] bodyguard [[Virus (Kaleesh)|Virus]] at the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] spaceport. Bliss and his partner engaged the Twi'lek and her Sith master in a brutal fight, but their enemies took the upper hand. With the Virus dead, Bliss was forced to give up the Star of Kala'unn and promise Vette that he would reform.
